comment: Which of a zone's layer filters (its LVB's layer sets, by ID) the client is told to show (ZoneInit's and ActorSetPos' transition_territory_filter_key), by quest progress. Retail's server picks it; the client's layout shows a layer only if its filter list has (or, for some, hasn't) that key, and with 0 in a zone like these every stage of the story stands there at once (Bob's Waking Sands screenshot, 2026-10-26). For each territory, the last entry whose quest has been accepted or completed applies (an entry without one is the default). Recorded: Bob's Chronofoil capture afe32479 visit 0.10 (2026-10-25), the Waking Sands during The Scions of the Seventh Dawn (509): 90338 in ZoneInit at its last step and in the ActorSetPos after it was completed; 90339 in the ActorSetPos as A Wild Rose by Any Other Name (510) was accepted, and after.
